environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Flask monolith directly via systemd unit. Instance is in a VPC subnet with full egress. The LDAP server (Active Directory on Windows Server 2019) is reachable at ldap://10.0.2.50:389 from the application. No input validation middleware, no WAF. The application binds with a service account that has read access to the entire directory tree. Security groups allow TCP 389 outbound to the LDAP server CIDR.

config.network: VPC subnet with 0.0.0.0/0 egress via NAT GW, SG allows TCP/389 to 10.0.2.0/24
config.ldap_server: Active Directory on 10.0.2.50:389, anonymous reads disabled but svc-app has subtree read
